note:
A separate namespace from nasa/ on purpose: this is NOAA's data, and labelling it NASA's would be the exact thing the attribution rules here exist to prevent. The licence was checked before anything was downloaded — NCEI's metadata record states the CC0-1.0 dedication explicitly, which is why this pack exists at all.

Same conventions as nasa/: equirectangular 2:1, longitude -180..+180, and 16-bit big-endian elevation where metres = value - 32768.
